title: Ghost in the Shell: Can a Log File Hijack an AI?
why_read: A hands-on experiment testing whether a prompt injection hidden in a log file can hijack an AI coding/analysis agent is a timely and concrete security demonstration.
analysis: The author embeds a hidden prompt injection inside a simulated 300-line application log file to see if an AI model processing the log will be manipulated into unintended behavior. This directly probes a known and growing risk category: indirect prompt injection via data that an AI reads rather than direct user input. Because AI agents increasingly summarize or act on logs, documents, and other unstructured data, this is a practical and relevant security test. The writeup promises concrete results across different models, which gives it real technical substance beyond pure speculation.
